title: Pipeline Evaluation
description: Structured output of a pipeline-evaluator skill run

pipelineId.description: Unique identifier for the evaluated pipeline

evaluatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the evaluation was performed

taskCount.description: Total number of tasks in the pipeline

taskCompletionRate.description: Percentage of tasks that reached completed status (0-100)

deviationCount.description: Total deviations logged across all task metadata

deviationScore.description: Inverse score derived from deviation count (100 = no deviations)

testPassRate.description: Percentage of test assertions that passed (0-100)

timeEfficiency.description: Ratio of estimated to actual duration, capped at 100

qualityScore.description: Code quality signal score based on lint/format/TODO markers (0-100)

compositeScore.description: Weighted composite of all dimension scores

verdict.description: Qualitative verdict derived from composite score

recommendations.description: Ranked list of actionable improvement recommendations

dimensionWeights.description: Weights used in composite score calculation
